scope_history.change: Formalized prior V5 website into V5.1 controlled digital release and added a B2B digital services revenue hypothesis. No physical-service bookings/payment/commission in scope.

process_improvements.lesson: Preview screenshots and design completeness must not be conflated with compiled React verification or a legally cleared public release.
process_improvements.control: Distinct stage 5 source-build, stage 6 runtime verification and stage 7 publication sign-off.
